## Project accounting

- [Project accounting](https://pawsey.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/US/pages/51925964/Job+Scheduling#JobScheduling-Projectaccounting)

Allocation usage:

```bash
pawseyAccountBalance -p <pawsey-project> 
```

By user:

```bash
pawseyAccountBalance -p <pawsey-project> -user
```

Include GPU allocation:

```bash
pawseyAccountBalance -p <pawsey-project>-gpu
```



## Disk usage 

Check usage on `/scratch`:

```bash
lfs quota /scratch
```

Check on `/home`: 
```bash
quota -s -f /home
```


## iNodes

The /scratch filesystem is a shared resource that suffers low performance when the number of files increases too much. Users should actively remove their files if no longer in use, rather than waiting for the system to delete them. For this, check Deleting Large Numbers of Files on Lustre Filesystems.

[Use of munlink for deleting large numbers of files from `scratch`](https://pawsey.atlassian.net/wiki/x/jFMYAw)
